defects.description: PR-v4 audit reverted both shoulders from -110 to -20 (abd ~20°, arms at side) claiming description indicates arm on chair. But actual INSTRUCTIONS say Drape the top arm along the backrest/armrest ABOVE THE HEAD, letting the elbow bend softly — top arm SHOULD be overhead. PR-v4 over-corrected based on misread description (likely confused with another lounge pose due to description-shuffling found in prior batches).
rightElbow=40 was set by PR-v4 (per its rationale Adjusting elbows to 40°). Tip says soft bend instead of rigid right angle — 40° is OK but slightly less than ideal soft bend (60°).

failing_tests.actual: both shoulders at -20 (abd ~83° — neither arm overhead)

regression_risk: medium — R shoulder changes from -20 to -110 (overhead); may render as arm draped above head along backrest OR as fully-extended overhead depending on viewer angle. Re-render verify REQUIRED.
rationale: Description: Drape the top arm along the backrest/armrest above the head. Body lies on LEFT side (globalRoll=+20 puts R shoulder higher: R y=0.714, L y=0.564). R arm is the TOP arm. PR-v4 reverted R shoulder to -20 (at side, wrong). Restoring rightShoulder=-110 (overhead, abd 120° — draped above head). rightElbow 40 to 60 (soft bend per tip: soft bend instead of rigid right angle). L arm (bottom, against chaise) PRESERVED at -20 with elbow 95 (forearm tucked under body, plausible for bottom arm). shoulderFwdL/R preserved (10/25, slight back swing toward backrest). globalTilt=+70 + globalRoll=+20 + globalTwist=+25 preserved (rig approximation for side-lying with torso twist toward camera).
